title: ¡Si, Yo Puedo Control Mi Diabetes!: A Diabetes Self-management Education Program for Hispanic/Latinos
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate the effectiveness of the íSi, Yo Puedo Controlar Mi Diabetes! (Yo Puedo) diabetes self-management education program.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Self-identification as Hispanic/Latino, over the age of 18 years of age, diagnosis of type 2 diabetes and willingness to participate in the diabetes self-management education class.

Exclusion Criteria: non-diabetic persons, non English-speaking Hispanic/Latinos with type 2 diabetes

\-
condition: Type 2 Diabetes, Hispanic/Latinos, Diabetes Self-management Education
